segments.source: Espresso evidence and its practical consequence
segments.context: Espresso assessment Espresso: fixed conditions shift the work to the grinder   8.8 out of 10   9Barista controls the water side of the recipe for you. The company specifies about 9 bar and 93°C, while the basket accepts 17–20 g and the collected output is normally around 40–45 g. That leaves coffee, dose, distribution and grind as the useful daily controls.This is not automatically limiting. A stable target can be liberating when you want a familiar espresso every morning. It becomes restrictive when a very light coffee asks for a different temperature, longer preinfusion or intentionally declining pressure.   Espresso evidence and its practical consequence   SignalWhat the evidence saysBuying consequence      Regulated brew stage 9Barista documents a mechanical twin-boiler system that reaches approximately 9 bar and controls brew water near 93°C.Treat it as an espresso brewer with a fixed operating point, not as a moka pot and not as a profiling machine.   53 mm basket The current Standard uses a 53 mm basket; Pro includes an IMS precision basket and naked portafilter.A capable espresso grinder and careful puck preparation remain essential even though the brewer regulates pressure.   Independent cup reports Tom’s Guide evaluated a Mk.2 Pro for roughly a month; Lance Hedrick demonstrated the Mk.2. Older Hoffmann, Bon Appétit and The Drive work covers the same core concept but not every Mk.2 revision.The evidence supports the concept, while generation labels should stay attached to any observation.   One output window The official target is approximately 40–45 g from a 17–20 g dose.Buy it for a compact double-espresso style result, not for one-touch singles, long drinks or freely selected brew ratios. Gaggia Naviglio HD8749/01 review: the model code is not Naviglio Milk | Coffeedant
A research-led correction of the Gaggia Naviglio HD8749/01 route, covering the black pannarello model, ceramic grinder, front-loading 1.5 L tank, £349 price and identity mismatch.
What milk work does Naviglio HD8749/01 leave to the user?

Prepare the coffee with the espresso or lungo button, then move to a pitcher and steam manually. The pannarello supplies aeration assistance; it does not turn this into the tube-fed Deluxe or Capp-in-Cup Naviglio Milk. That distinction changes the work on every milk drink.
How much grinder adjustment does Naviglio HD8749/01 offer?
Ceramic burr grinder with five adjustment positions and Gaggia adapting logic
What should I check before ordering Naviglio HD8749/01?

Ignore the word “Milk” in this historical route: HD8749/01 is the black 230 V Naviglio with a manual plastic pannarello. Verify photographs and the code before ordering, especially if the advertised reason to buy is automatic cappuccino.
Why might I choose a different model?
The route name misstates the model, the unit is 230V, and manual pannarello milk is not one-touch
Which coffee recipes and controls does Naviglio HD8749/01 provide?
One-touch espresso and espresso lungo plus hot water and steam, three Optiaroma strengths, programmable length, pre-infusion and two-cycle black coffee
What care does this particular milk system add?

The removable pannarello needs cleaning after steaming, in addition to brew-group care. Clear the 10-puck bin and front tray regularly; taking the water tank out from the front is convenient only when the counter remains clear enough for removal.
Gaggia Naviglio HD8749/01 review: the model code is not Naviglio Milk
